title: GTA 6: Did the ‘extended look’ trailer live up to the hype?
description:
Rockstar — the developer behind Grand Theft Auto 6 — has released the “extended look” trailer ahead of the game’s November release. The 26-minute preview offers fans the first detailed footage from the game. Among other things, the trailer showcases the relationship between protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Camino and some very impressive chase scenes.

The extended look premiered following a week of leaks. We get reaction from some popular gamers and content creators: Alogirlx in Canada, ColdJinn in India, Knightenator in the UK, and Nixstah in the United States. Plus BBC reporter Tom Richardson explains why people have been leaking content from the game and what the potential impact could be.

Email: whatintheworld@bbc.co.uk WhatsApp: +44 330 12 33 22 6 Presenter: Iqra Farooq Producers: Chelsea Coates and William Lee Adams Editor: Verity Wilde
summaryZh: 本集 BBC 節目《What in the World》探討 GTA VI 釋出 26 分鐘預告片後的玩家熱烈反應與外洩事件。主持人 Iqra Farooq 邀請多位遊戲創作者分享看法，他們盛讚遊戲的視覺效果與細節，並表示外洩影片並未影響期待感。BBC 記者 Tom Richardson 則說明了畫面外洩的經過、開發商 Rockstar Games 的遺憾聲明，以及外洩者可能出於抗議數位版發行或求取加密貨幣資助的動機。最後，節目討論了這款等待 13 年的遊戲作品是否真能符合大眾的高度期待。
summaryEn: In this episode of What in the World, host Iqra Farooq discusses the newly released 26-minute trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) ahead of its scheduled November release. Content creators Alogirlx, ColdJinn, Knightenator, and Nixstah share their enthusiasm for the game's visuals, map detail, and updated mechanics, agreeing that recent leaks have not spoiled their hype. BBC reporter Tom Richardson explains how early gameplay footage leaked online, Rockstar Games' statement expressing heartbreak for the developers, the potential motives behind the leaks—including protests against digital-only releases and requests for cryptocurrency donations—and whether the game can live up to 13 years of anticipation.
